in_marathi.name: Shamna
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Goddess of Love and Beauty
in_marathi.long_meaning: Shamna हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Shamna is derived from the Sanskrit word Shama, which means calming, soothing, and tranquil. In Hindu mythology, Shamna is the name of a goddess who is the embodiment of love, beauty, and the moon. She is often depicted with a crescent moon on her forehead and is believed to bring peace and prosperity.
